custom_dimensions.rationale: Which entry point (home hero, check page, sticky bar) produced completed and qualified checks. Decides where the free check is placed. Closed three-value enum.
Which tier (T2 or T3) a checkout intent started for. Decides which offer is promoted. Purchase already carries the tier as the built-in item variant.

key_events.rationale: A session that produced at least one supportive outcome from a live lookup. Once per session so rechecking the same parcel is one qualified visit, not several.
Server-side purchase from the signed webhook after settlement and the durable PAID transition. Behavioral evidence only: paid revenue is the Stripe/order record.
